title: Portuguese Java OOP inheritance and polymorphism tests
summary: Second-year computer engineering students complete Portuguese-language Java tests requiring several interacting classes, inheritance, composition, polymorphism, and prescribed design conventions. Six authentic versions were benchmarked with GPT-3, but the student assessments themselves use automated tests and code-quality rules rather than a reported student-facing AI role.

sources.title: GPT-3 vs Object Oriented Programming Assignments: An Experience Report
sources.evidence_quote: we analyzed 6 assignments that have been used in our course as tests focused on inheritance and polymorphism

assessment.summary: Implement a multi-class Java system from a Portuguese business-domain specification while meeting functional and object-oriented design requirements.
student_actions: Design and implement related Java classes.
Apply inheritance, composition, encapsulation, and polymorphism.
Submit code to the Drop Project automated assessment tool.

student_role.description: Researchers tested GPT-3 against six authentic assessments; the paper does not establish permitted student AI use for those tests.

grading.method: Drop Project unit tests plus code-quality rules, including penalties for explicit type testing such as instanceof or getClass().
